summary: MindWalk Holdings Corp. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the filing of a European patent application for high-dimensional biological data architecture used in AI drug discovery. This is a routine intellectual property disclosure with no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The filing does not meet the threshold for a special situation and falls outside the defined categories.
